Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The refusal now tells the user to regenerate the threading operation. The refusal condition stays the same.
The tests check cached zero finish allowance records in mm and inch. They also check the existing Fanuc output.

I checked the laws in upstream/main AGENTS.md at c0c92ee865ae3c19a5bd4e8d7904c8ad2b5b29c7.
The trial merge with that main was clean. The PR already contains that main.

Notes:

- This change only adds text to a diagnostic. It does not change posted G-code, refusal conditions, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation.
- Safety-tier mutations are not required for this change. I did not repeat the author's mutation run.
- No goldens changed. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required.
- I did not run a physical controller or the GUI recovery workflow.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
